description: This Java class 'MoneyHelperInitializationService' provides methods to initialize and check the configuration of 'MoneyHelper' for multi-tenant environments within the Fineract platform. It manages tenant-specific rounding modes based on global configuration settings.

classes.name: MoneyHelperInitializationService
classes.description: Service to initialize MoneyHelper configurations for multi-tenant environments, managing tenant-specific rounding modes based on global configuration.

methods.name: initializeTenantRoundingMode
methods.description: Initializes MoneyHelper for a specific tenant by setting tenant context, retrieving rounding mode from configuration, and applying it.

methods.name: isTenantInitialized
methods.description: Checks if MoneyHelper has been initialized for a given tenant identifier.

methods.name: getRoundingModeFromConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the rounding mode value from global configuration, with fallback to default.
